title: One-Pot Stovetop Mac & Cheese (Thanksgiving Make-Ahead)
subtitle: Adapted from Brian Lagerstrom’s “Better” Stovetop Method — scaled for 1 lb cavatappi, medium cheddar, and a make-ahead Thanksgiving baked finish.
description: Adapted from Brian Lagerstrom's 'Better' Stovetop Method — scaled for 1 lb cavatappi, medium cheddar, and a make-ahead Thanksgiving baked finish.
eyebrow: Holiday Side Dish • Scaled 2× Batch (1 lb Pasta)
author: Steven Horvat
keywords: mac and cheese, cavatappi, thanksgiving, make-ahead, stovetop mac and cheese, medium cheddar

image.alt: Golden broiled cavatappi mac and cheese bubbling in a 9×13-inch ceramic casserole dish
image.caption: One-pot creamy cavatappi base built Wednesday, loosened & broiled golden on Thanksgiving Day.

ingredients.name: evaporated milk
ingredients.note: requires two 12 fl oz cans; save leftover milk for Thursday
ingredients.schemaText: 450g (2 cups) evaporated milk (requires two 12 fl oz cans; save leftover milk for Thursday)

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: plus extra to taste at the end
ingredients.schemaText: 12g (2 tsp) kosher salt (plus extra to taste at the end)

ingredients.name: unsalted butter
ingredients.note: cut into a few pieces for faster melting
ingredients.schemaText: 100g (7 Tbsp) unsalted butter (cut into a few pieces for faster melting)

ingredients.name: deli American cheese
ingredients.note: white or yellow; acts as the sauce emulsifier
ingredients.schemaText: 10 slices (~180g / 6 oz) deli American cheese (white or yellow; acts as the sauce emulsifier)

ingredients.name: medium cheddar cheese, freshly grated
ingredients.note: grate from a block, not pre-shredded
ingredients.schemaText: 250g (2½–3 cups) medium cheddar cheese, freshly grated from a block

ingredients.name: aged Parmesan cheese, finely grated
ingredients.note: grated on the fine/feather side of a box grater
ingredients.schemaText: 50–60g (~½ cup) aged Parmesan cheese, finely grated

ingredients.name: reserved evaporated milk or whole milk
ingredients.note: for loosening before reheating on Thursday
ingredients.schemaText: 60–120g (¼–½ cup) reserved evaporated milk or whole milk (for loosening before reheating on Thursday)

ingredients.name: extra medium cheddar cheese, freshly grated
ingredients.schemaText: 100g (~1 cup) extra medium cheddar cheese, freshly grated (for the Thanksgiving casserole topping)

steps.title: Prep & grate all cheeses first
bullets: Freshly grate 250g (2½–3 cups) medium cheddar for the sauce.
Freshly grate 100g (~1 cup) medium cheddar for Thursday’s topping; bag and refrigerate separately.
Finely grate 50–60g (~½ cup) aged Parmesan on the fine side of a grater and unwrap 10 slices American cheese.
steps.schemaText: Freshly grate 250g (2½–3 cups) medium cheddar for the sauce. Freshly grate 100g (~1 cup) medium cheddar for Thursday's topping; bag and refrigerate separately. Finely grate 50–60g (~½ cup) aged Parmesan on the fine side of a grater and unwrap 10 slices American cheese.

steps.title: Boil the cooking liquid
bullets: Combine 1,500g (6½ cups) water, 450g (2 cups) evaporated milk, and 12g (2 tsp) kosher salt in a large Dutch oven.
Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally so the milk doesn’t scorch.
steps.schemaText: Combine 1,500g (6½ cups) water, 450g (2 cups) evaporated milk, and 12g (2 tsp) kosher salt in a large Dutch oven. Bring to a boil over high heat, stirring occasionally so the milk doesn't scorch.

steps.title: Simmer cavatappi to firm al dente
bullets: Stir in 454g (1 lb) cavatappi, cover, and lower heat to medium.
Cook covered for 10–11 minutes (just shy of Barilla’s 11–12 min package mark so it finishes tender after reheating), stirring every 2 minutes so nothing sticks.
Pull from heat as soon as the chalky center is gone and a starchy pool of liquid remains.
steps.schemaText: Stir in 454g (1 lb) cavatappi, cover, and lower heat to medium. Cook covered for 10–11 minutes, stirring every 2 minutes so nothing sticks. Pull from heat as soon as the chalky center is gone and a starchy pool of liquid remains.

steps.title: Melt in the butter
bullets: Turn heat to low and add 100g (7 Tbsp) unsalted butter.
Stir gently until completely melted into the starchy liquid.
steps.schemaText: Turn heat to low and add 100g (7 Tbsp) unsalted butter. Stir gently until completely melted into the starchy liquid.

steps.title: Emulsify the cheese sauce
bullets: Keeping heat on low, add 10 slices American cheese (torn), 250g (2½–3 cups) medium cheddar, and 50–60g (~½ cup) Parmesan in two batches.
Stir constantly until smooth and glossy; taste and season with kosher salt if needed. (Sauce should look slightly looser than normal so it hydrates properly overnight.)
steps.schemaText: Keeping heat on low, add 10 slices American cheese (torn), 250g (2½–3 cups) medium cheddar, and 50–60g (~½ cup) Parmesan in two batches. Stir constantly until smooth and glossy; taste and season with kosher salt if needed.

steps.title: Chill overnight
bullets: Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch casserole dish and cool 20 minutes at room temperature.
Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate overnight (keep the topping cheese off until Thursday).
steps.schemaText: Transfer to a greased 9×13-inch casserole dish and cool 20 minutes at room temperature. Cover tightly with foil and refrigerate overnight (keep the topping cheese off until Thursday).

steps.title: Temper & preheat
bullets: Pull the dish from the fridge 30–45 minutes before baking; preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
steps.schemaText: Pull the dish from the fridge 30–45 minutes before baking; preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).

steps.title: Loosen & bake covered
bullets: Drizzle 60–120g (¼–½ cup) leftover evaporated milk or whole milk over the pasta and stir gently.
Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20–25 minutes until hot and bubbling at the edges.
steps.schemaText: Drizzle 60–120g (¼–½ cup) leftover evaporated milk or whole milk over the pasta and stir gently. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 20–25 minutes until hot and bubbling at the edges.

steps.title: Top with cheddar & broil
bullets: Remove foil and scatter the reserved 100g (~1 cup) medium cheddar evenly over the top.
Broil on High (6–8 inches below element) for 2–3 minutes until melted and lightly browned. Rest 5 minutes before serving.
steps.schemaText: Remove foil and scatter the reserved 100g (~1 cup) medium cheddar evenly over the top. Broil on High (6–8 inches below element) for 2–3 minutes until melted and lightly browned. Rest 5 minutes before serving.
